agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor called the regular September 19, 2000 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CITIZEN PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Councilmember Morzel requested a report regarding further treatments for the intersections of Valmont and Airport and Valmont and Kings Ridge, as well as a report regarding a time signal at the intersection of Iris and 28th.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM SEPTEMBER 5, 2000.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

agenda_items.title: THIRD READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE NO. 7079 AMENDING CHAPTERS 9-1, 9-3.2, 9-3.3, 9-3.4, 9-3.5, 9-4 AND 9-8 OF TITLE 9, LAND USE REGULATIONS, B.R.C. 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE NO. 7081, AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 6-2-5, B.R.C. 1981, IN ORDER TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF THE COLORADO NOXIOUS WEED ACT, AND ADDING SECTION 6-2-10, B.R.C. 1981, DESIGNATING CITY COUNCIL AS THE LOCAL ADVISORY BOARD.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE NO. 7082 APPROVING SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATIONS TO THE 2000 BUDGET.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION APPROVING THE JOINT PURCHASE WITH BOULDER COUNTY OF 148.73 ACRES OWNED BY THE CITO COMPANY LOCATED ON GUNBARREL HILL, JUST SOUTH OF MINERAL ROAD AND EAST OF 79 TH STREET FOR OPEN SPACE PURPOSES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to request that Planning Board evaluate the elimination of the Planning Reserve by changing it to a Rural Preserve in addition to the current proposal to change to 159 acres of Planning Reserve to Rural Preserve adopted by Council on September 5, 2000.

agenda_items.title: REPORT ON THE BOULDER VALLEY COMPREHENSIVE PLAN UPDATE PROCESS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to request that Planning Board evaluate the elimination of the Planning Reserve by changing it to a Rural Preserve in addition to the current proposal to change to 159 acres of Planning Reserve to Rural Preserve adopted by Council on September 5, 2000.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to adopt Resolution No. 862, encouraging the citizens of the City of Boulder to oppose Amendment No. 21 also known as "Taxcut 2000," when voting in the November 7, 2000 election.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ENCOURAGING THE CITIZENS OF THE CITY OF BOULDER TO OPPOSE AMENDMENT NO. 21 ALSO KNOWN A“TAXCUT 2000,” WHEN VOTING IN THE NOVEMBER 7, 2000 ELECTION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to adopt Resolution No. 862, encouraging the citizens of the City of Boulder to oppose Amendment No. 21 also known as "Taxcut 2000," when voting in the November 7, 2000 election.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO SUPPORT BOULDER COUNTY BALLOT QUESTION 1B AUTHORIZING THE EXTENSION OF THE COUNTY'S EXISTING .10% RECYCLING AND COMPOSTING SALES AND USE TAX FOR EIGHT YEARS AND FOR THE ISSUANCE OF UP TO $80,800,000 IN BONDS, FOR THE PURCHASE AND MAINTENANCE OF OPEN SPACE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to support Boulder County Ballot Question 1B authorizing the extension of the County's existing .10% recycling and composting sales and use tax for eight years and for the issuance of up to $80,800,000 in bonds, for the purchase and maintenance of open space.

agenda_items.title: FINAL DECISIONS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-E.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE NO. 7078, ADOPTING CHAPTER 6-12, B.R.C. 1981, REGULATING TRASH HAULERS AND RECYCLABLE MATERIALS, AND SETTING FORTH DETAILS IN RELATION THERETO.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Mock, to adopt Ordinance No.7078, adopting Chapter 6-12, B.R.C. 1981, regulating trash haulers and recyclable materials as amended.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION ACCEPTING THE GREENWAYS MASTER PLAN PROJECTS AND OPPORTUNITIES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Riggle, to approve the Greenways Master Plan projects and opportunities.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTIONS 5-6-2 AND 5-6-6, B.R.C. 1981, CONCERNING BLANK CARTRIDGES, FIREWORKS, AND EXEMPTING CERTAIN DEVICES USED FOR CEREMONIAL OR OTHER PURPOSES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Lopez, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No.7083, amending Sections 5-6-2 and 5-6-6, B.R.C. 1981, concerning blank cartridges, fireworks, and exempting certain devices for ceremonial or other purposes as amended.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel, to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-E.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Riggle, to request that Planning Board evaluate the elimination of the Planning Reserve by changing it to a Rural Preserve in addition to the current proposal to change to 159 acres of Planning Reserve to Rural Preserve adopted by Council on September 5, 2000.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5-2, Corson and Lopez opposed, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Mock , to adopt Option No. 3, to defer Land Use Map changes for Area Plans.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 4-3, Corson, Lopez and Poinsatte opposed, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to direct staff to look at the potential for reducing Commercial Land Use Designations in Area 1 (including options for reducing job growth).
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 6 - 1, Lopez opposed, Eldridge and Havlick.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel, to adopt Resolution No. 862. encouraging the citizens of the City of Boulder to oppose Amendment No. 21 also known as “Taxcut 2000,” when voting in the November 7, 2000 election.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Morzel, to support Boulder County Ballot Question 1B authorizing the extension of the County's existing .10% recycling and composting sales and use tax for eight years and for the issuance of up to $80,800,000 in bonds, for the purchase and maintenance of open space.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Mock, to adopt Ordinance No.7078, adopting Chapter 6-12, B.R.C. 1981, regulating trash haulers and recyclable materials as amended.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Riggle, to approve the Greenways Master Plan projects and opportunities.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0. Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Lopez, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No.7083, amending Sections 5-6-2 and 5-6-6, B.R.C. 1981, concerning blank cartridges, fireworks, and exempting certain devices for ceremonial or other purposes as amended.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:45 p.m.
